_note: Provenance file of the published run (data/provenance.json), with its Indonesian text translated into English for the public release (2026-11-21). Values are otherwise unchanged.

changes.why: The PSL DMI (HadISST1.1) ends in 2026-05 (2026-06 onward = -9999); the second URL returns HTTP 404. Predictors are needed until 2026-08. Replaced by the official monthly NOAA CPC DMI series (ERSSTv6, 1991-2020 climatology), 1950-01 to 2026-08, one source for the whole panel. CPC: values may change for up to 2 months after the first release.

cems-fire-historical-v1 is no longer in the CDS catalogue ('process not found'); the same dataset is in the Copernicus Early Warning Data Store (EWDS). The EWDS request schema was checked: all keys and values in fwi_cds.request are valid (reanalysis, fire_weather_index, consolidated/intermediate_dataset, system_version 4_1, grid 0.25/0.25, netcdf).

changes.before: data/raw/peat/peta_gambut.gpkg (BBSDLP 2019, 1:50,000; Anda et al., 2021) - not available

source.dataset: PEATMAP (Xu, Morris, Liu & Holden 2017/2018), file Asia.zip -> Asia/SEA_Peatland.shp
source.indonesia_source_per_peatmap: Ritung et al. (2011), BBSDLP, 1:250,000, data 2005-2010 ('Indonesia Peat Lands'); Malaysia (part of the Kalimantan bounding box): Wetlands International (2010) 1:50,000
source.processing: SEA_Peatland (ESRI:54034) -> EPSG:4326, make_valid, clip to the bounding boxes in config.regions, explode (1,186 polygons: sumatra 446, kalimantan 633, papua_selatan 107)

changes.why: The polygons of the 2019 BBSDLP map could not be downloaded legally with a licence (the BBSDLP/BSIP site and the repository of the Ministry of Agriculture were not accessible; Ina-Geoportal has only province/regency layers; Trase has only aggregate areas; the copy of Yayasan Gambut covers only Riau and has no licence). The user chose the global map (option 3) on 2026-09-30. Table 1 of the manuscript changed.

changes.before: mean of all 10 m pixels per 0.01-degree cell (reduceResolution mean, maxPixels 65535)
changes.after: mean of a systematic sample of 10 x 10 points per cell (nearest-neighbour reprojection to a 0.001-degree grid, then reduceResolution mean)
changes.why: The full mean exceeded the Earth Engine memory limits (interactive and batch, including tileScale 8) and ran at about 1 cell per second (several days); the project asset root was not available. Validation on 800 cells (Riau, Central Kalimantan; 2023): per-band correlation median 0.999 (minimum 0.996), mean error 2.7 % of the between-cell SD, correlation of the 8 principal components 0.997-1.000 (logs/emb_sample_validation.txt).

sp_nrt_overlap: overlapping NRT not available: NRT archive starts 2026-07-01, SP archive ends 2026-06-30

adm1.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0
adm1.check_2022_provinces: not included (Papua Selatan, Papua Tengah, Papua Pegunungan, Papua Barat Daya); their area still belongs to the polygon 'Papua'. Cells in the papua_selatan box are labelled with the region of that box (column region).

susc.code: gee_fetch.py --kind susc (susc_phys_image, susc_keep, static_once_image, embedding_image); peat_fraction.py --table-in data/followup/susc_gee.csv --table-out data/followup/susc_cells.csv

sources.rain_annual, dry_days_aso: UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY 2012-2018, bilinear resampling; total / 7; days < 1 mm in Aug-Oct / 7
sources.swvl1_aso, t2m_annual: ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR 2012-2018, bilinear resampling; mean of Aug-Oct / mean of all months
sources.wc_*, in_indonesia: ESA/WorldCover/v200, USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017 (static_once_image, as in the main run)
sources.emb_*: AlphaEarth 2017 and 2018, systematic 10x10 sample (embedding_image, as in the main run), mean of the two years

susc.checks: see logs/followup_susc_checks.txt: required columns complete; NaN in land cells only for swvl1_aso/t2m_annual (0.08 %); candidate cells vs data/cube/static.csv: embeddings 2017-18 differ by at most 5e-06 (rounding), in_indonesia/wc_water/wc_tree/peat_frac identical
